# Sriraj Guttapalyam: technical writing portfolio

> Senior technical writer with 10+ years of experience in API documentation, docs-as-code, AI-assisted documentation workflows, and structured authoring. The samples use public or fictional products.

## Start here
- [Portfolio Portal](https://sriraj-guttapalyam.github.io/technical-writing-portfolio/): flagship samples and full domain catalog
- [Repository README](https://github.com/sriraj-guttapalyam/technical-writing-portfolio/blob/main/README.md): overview, samples, experience, and tools
- [Review map](https://github.com/sriraj-guttapalyam/technical-writing-portfolio/blob/main/PORTFOLIO_CONTENT_GUIDE.md): where each skill shows and how the samples are checked
- [Authorship and validation](https://sriraj-guttapalyam.github.io/technical-writing-portfolio/docs/portfolio-evidence): human decisions, AI assistance, checks, and limitations

## Flagship samples
- [API reference](https://sriraj-guttapalyam.github.io/technical-writing-portfolio/docs/api-reference): GitHub REST parameters, pagination, nullable fields, and error recovery
- [Webhook integration](https://sriraj-guttapalyam.github.io/technical-writing-portfolio/docs/webhook-integration): HMAC-SHA256 verification, idempotency, and unit-tested Python
- [Docs as code](https://sriraj-guttapalyam.github.io/technical-writing-portfolio/docs/docs-as-code): pull-request review, source checks, and Docusaurus build validation
- [AI documentation case study](https://sriraj-guttapalyam.github.io/technical-writing-portfolio/docs/ai-ready-content): retrieval baseline, metadata, limitations, and human-in-the-loop workflow

## AI and content strategy
- [AI-ready content](https://sriraj-guttapalyam.github.io/technical-writing-portfolio/docs/ai-ready-content): chunking, metadata, and a hand-run retrieval test
- [AI workflows](https://sriraj-guttapalyam.github.io/technical-writing-portfolio/docs/ai-workflows): human-in-the-loop process, prompts, agent rules, style checklist
- [Cursor + MadCap Flare workflow](https://sriraj-guttapalyam.github.io/technical-writing-portfolio/docs/cursor-flare-workflow): multi-source synthesis from Jira, Confluence, Teams, email, video, and QA into Flare XHTML
- [Information architecture](https://sriraj-guttapalyam.github.io/technical-writing-portfolio/docs/doc-architecture): content model, taxonomy, reuse, governance
